policy: Coverage fail_under is a one-way ratchet. Raise when classical/core coverage improves; never lower to silence regressions. Floors must be set from a full-suite measure (scripts/run_full_coverage.py or CI pytest --cov=buildml), never from a tiny subset.

schedule.notes: Interim floor after partial-suite ~26%; replaced once full-suite measured ~70.7%
Skipped; full-suite already cleared 60 with headroom
Full-suite Windows isolated combine measured 70.71% (39539/55914); ~10pp headroom. Linux CI monolith is the gate.
Industry-comparable floor; require >=1.0pp headroom on Linux CI full suite after reducing Windows native crashes

how_to_raise: Run: python scripts/run_full_coverage.py --update-ratchet (isolated on Windows; monolith on Linux)
Confirm TOTAL exceeds the next target with >=1.0pp headroom on the gate platform (Linux CI)
Bump fail_under in pyproject.toml and this file's current field
Update CONTRIBUTING.md ratchet note, docs/stability.md, and CHANGELOG

measured.command: pytest per-module isolated (189 modules) + coverage combine
